description: Search, browse and filter a public catalog of red, white, sparkling, rosé, dessert and port wines. No API key, login or proxy setup required.

filterCountry.description: Only return wines from one of the catalog's countries. Leave 'All countries' for no filter.
filterCountry.title: Filter by country

filterRegion.description: Only return wines from this region (e.g. 'Bordeaux', 'Napa Valley', 'Champagne'). Case-insensitive partial match.
filterRegion.title: Filter by region

filterWinery.description: Only return wines from this winery. Case-insensitive partial match.
filterWinery.title: Filter by winery

minRating.description: Only return wines with a community rating at or above this value (1.0–5.0).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Only return wines backed by at least this many community ratings. Useful for filtering out obscure bottles.
minReviews.title: Minimum ratings count

enumTitles: Search wines by keyword or filters
Look up specific wines by ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Words matched against the wine name, winery, country and region. Every word must match. Leave empty to keep every wine. Example: 'cabernet' or 'champagne brut'.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Order of the emitted records. 'Catalog order' keeps the source order.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

vintageMax.description: Only return wines with a vintage year at or before this value. Non-vintage wines are excluded when a vintage filter is set.
vintageMax.title: Vintage year (max)

vintageMin.description: Only return wines with a vintage year at or after this value. Non-vintage wines are excluded when a vintage filter is set.
vintageMin.title: Vintage year (min)

wineIds.description: Wines to look up when mode=byIds. Use 'type/id' (e.g. 'reds/4') or a full source URL. Each entry needs a type because IDs repeat across categories.
wineIds.title: Wine IDs or URLs

wineType.description: Wine category to browse or filter. In byIds mode, references from other categories are skipped. 'All' covers every category.
wineType.title: Wine type

title: Wine Catalog Search Input
